name: High Fructose
detailed_description:
High Fructose is a high-speed, semi-open roguelite FPS set in sprawling, procedurally generated battlefields. Every run drops you into a fresh, layered playground built for wall-running, dashing, double-jumping, and total movement freedom. Explore, improvise, and unleash chaos with your evolving arsenal.

Play as one of four superpowered animal ninjas — Fox, Elephant, Wolverine, or Monkey — waging an all-out war against a fruit-infested world twisted by demonic corruption. Slice, smash, and blast your way through waves of cursed produce in your fight to cleanse the land.

                            🍉 Imagine Demonic Fruit Ninja meets Ghostrunner with Guns

You're a supernatural warrior slicing through waves of mutant, possessed fruit, guided by a mysterious ghost as you fight to cleanse the orchard.

🍇 Key Features

⚔️ Procedural Arenas
Battle in semi-open, procedurally generated orchards warped by dark magic — new layouts every run.

👻 Haunted Culinary Combat
Slice enemies in cursed recipe combos to earn XP, coins, or devastating supernatural power-ups.

🔫 Juiced Arsenal
Equip everything from swords and wands to AK-47s and panda-firing cannons. Carry a dedicated melee weapon to slice possessed fruit up close.

⚡ Rapid-Fire Action
Dash, bend time, and survive intense 30-minute runs packed with fast-paced, precision mayhem.

👹 Possessed Fruit Enemies
Face off against evolving monstrosities like the Banana Snake, Cherry Cannons, and Dragonfruit Dragons — all infected by demonic corruption.

🛍️ Between-Wave Upgrades
Gather ghost coins and cursed juice to buy weapons, perks, and game-changing gear mid-run.

🌱 Persistent Power-Ups
Collect seeds to grow stronger every run — unlock permanent upgrades and discover new dark recipes.
